title: Run a saved digital process through the common working view
summary: Fresh read-only continuation verifies the one actual common-view-started process completed, its five exact outputs and same-run refresh/reload. The prior label assumption failure is retained. No new execution, generated interface, model, integration policy, review or physical action.

manualSteps.label: Open completed run

manualSteps.label: Completion

manualSteps.label: Results
manualSteps.instruction: Scroll to Results and checks, then reload the workspace.
